create_ocr_mac_model: create an OcrMacModel instance for macOS document OCR with enabled flag, artifacts path, options, and accelerator options
run_ocr_on_pages: run OCR on a batch of Page objects using OcrMacModel and yield pages with detected text cells
get_ocr_rects: get OCR region-of-interest rectangles for a given Page to limit OCR processing areas
post_process_cells: post-process OCR-detected text cells by deduplicating and merging overlapping cells for a Page
get_options_type: get the OcrMacOptions type class for configuring OCR recognition, framework, and language preferences
